steps.name: Support for rebuilding Jude Kingdom (1)
steps.objective: After talking to [Melvik] in the “Underground City of Tartarus,” obtain <Golden Apple>, <Secret Sheet Music>, and <Magnetic Weapon> and report them to [Layer] in the “Underground City of Tartarus.”

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Thank you for your interest in supporting the rebuilding of the Judean Kingdom.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What? Then, can you tell me? I'd like to try it if I can... .

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Of course. As you may know, the Kingdom of Jude wants a close cooperative relationship with various powers in Eastland.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Actually, if you look at it, part of Tartarus is the territory of the Kingdom of Jude, but it was also abandoned due to the reluctance to develop the devastated Amalun Desert.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Shinik said to such an area, "I do what I want here? Okay?" We handled it that way and started development right away.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. also… .

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Then, the Kingdom of Jude was attacked by the Kingdom of Mos, and it needed a lot of help during reconstruction.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: I'm not sure what it's like in other places, but the Kingdom of Jude wants a close cooperative relationship with Tartarus.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Lord Basil of the Festo Territory in the eastern border area cares enough to send his lady Violet personally.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: I think we should continue to maintain a relationship with Jude Kingdom, so I'm telling you to Shinik... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: After all, it's not fun or anything like that?

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Yes, because it’s the time when you say you don’t have fun no matter what you do… .

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: So, I think we need some fun stuff. Wouldn’t it change your mind if you found something interesting?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A person who only moves when he has fun... .

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Because that's Shinik. Hehehe.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: I've found some interesting items, and I'd like you to get them for me. If you can't save me, Shinik, what might you do?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mr. Melvik, don’t do this even if it’s just a joke… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay. Let's get those items!

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Then, please bring whatever you ask for to Layer. thank you

steps.name: Support for rebuilding Jude Kingdom (2)
steps.objective: Obtain the <Traveler's Ring> and report it to [Xerix] at the "Luman Alliance Headquarters".

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: I heard the story. If Mr. Shinick brings something interesting, ask him to take care of it... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, it's here.

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: Then I will put it away in the warehouse. But why are you staring at me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I felt strong combat power. Just by looking at it, it looks like you have great skills.

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: Did you get caught? Ahahaha. He's just a retired old man.

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: Ah, my introduction was late. I am Layer, I was once a mercenary roaming the desert.

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: Currently, I am working in a warehouse in Tartarus at Shinik's request.

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: You look amazing like that too. Seeing how well you are able to obtain the items that Mr. Shinik requested.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It was a bit difficult.

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: But why did you get this item?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's it... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Layer that Melvik asked him to do the job.)

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: Something like that happened. I think we should help Melvik more with what he is doing... . If possible, how about receiving a clear promise of support from other sources?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think that would be a good idea.

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: I once received help from Lord Basil, so I would like to return the favor in some small way... . Let's see.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You look happy?

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: Suddenly a thought came to me... . Oh, if you're from Luman, you probably know Xerix, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, of course I know. Although he is arrogant, arrogant and inconsiderate, he is said to be ‘Xerix’, a master of perfect financial management and Lu Man’s main butler.

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: The evaluation of that shy person has changed so much. Go to him and tell him I sent it, and he will take care of it.

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: Xerix: I think he may still have some feelings of resentment towards me. ha ha ha.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't really know what you're talking about, but I don't think we should just keep going like this.

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: Then it would be a good idea to grab something and take it as a gift. What would be better?

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: Ah, this would be nice. I think you can give me a bunch of traveler's rings.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Can I just get that for you?

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: Yeah. Then it will take care of itself. So much so that the rebuilding of the Kingdom of Judd is happening incredibly quickly.
Yes. Then I'll come right away.

steps.name: Support for rebuilding Jude Kingdom (3)
steps.objective: Talk to [Melvik] in the “Underground City of Tartarus.”

lines.speaker: 제릭스
lines.text: I can still smell blood... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A lot has happened in the meantime.

lines.speaker: 제릭스
lines.text: I heard you were leaving, have you left yet?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I went to Tartarus and something happened so I came back briefly.

lines.speaker: 제릭스
lines.text: You're from Tartarus?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Mr. Layer said he had a favor to ask.

lines.speaker: 제릭스
lines.text: Who? Layers?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I came here at Layer's request.

lines.speaker: 제릭스
lines.text: I'll pretend I didn't hear it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mr. Layer said that he would like to repay a favor to Lord Basil of the southern territory of Jude Kingdom, and that he thought it would be okay to ask Xerix... .

lines.speaker: 제릭스
lines.text: Ugh, I wonder how many decades that kid has been messing with this. The ring continues to grow as the years go by.

lines.speaker: 제릭스
lines.text: No matter how much I got kicked, if I take this as a weakness... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Heh, that was it.

lines.speaker: 아리안느
lines.text: Phew… .

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: Of course I think that can happen.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Hmm… It was a car.

lines.speaker: 휴고
lines.text: Too bad... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The atmosphere is strange, so he prepares to run away. However, he is soon caught by Xerix.)

lines.speaker: 제릭스
lines.text: Whoa, where are we going?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hahaha, no. no.

lines.speaker: 제릭스
lines.text: I can't help it. Because this isn't the layer's fault.

lines.speaker: 제릭스
lines.text: Those are all Melvik guys… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Melvik?)

lines.speaker: 제릭스
lines.text: He calls me his teacher and orders me everything to eat. Now that you understand, I promise to support Tartarus and the Kingdom of Jude once more in Luman.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, thank you.

lines.speaker: 제릭스
lines.text: Go back and tell Melvik to stop because he will increase his support!! This bad guy... . What number is it?

steps.name: Support for rebuilding Jude Kingdom (4)
steps.objective: Talk to [Violette] in the “Underground City of Tartarus.”

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Hehe, you brought good news from Luman.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, that's right.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Go to Xerix and explain what happened to Melvik.)

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Hehehe. As expected, my true teacher.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: I will use it often in the future. You've already helped me a lot, so I don't think there's any reason for me to turn down your continued help.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (In some ways, he is even better than Shinik.)

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Hehehe. What are you thinking about?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, no.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: In the meantime, Shinik promised support for the Kingdom of Jude.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank goodness!

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: I think it was worth waiting until I received confirmation from Luman. I want you to go and tell Violette this good news.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How about delivering it directly from Melvik?

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: I think it's better for Adventurer to do it than me. I guess it gives us more faith when someone who follows God makes promises.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will.

lines.speaker: 비올렛
lines.text: … Hey, %s. nice to meet you!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Violet, how are you?

lines.speaker: 비올렛
lines.text: I was sorry that I wasn't able to properly thank you when you helped Jude Kingdom in the past.

lines.speaker: 비올렛
lines.text: I heard you came to Tartarus, but I was late to greet you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No. I already have something to talk about.

lines.speaker: 비올렛
lines.text: Yes? what… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It is said that support was promised in Tartarus and Luman in relation to the rebuilding of the Kingdom of Jude.)

lines.speaker: 비올렛
lines.text: Really? Thank you so much.

lines.speaker: 비올렛
lines.text: Shinik seems to be in a really bad mood these days, so I've been thinking a lot about what to do.

lines.speaker: 비올렛
lines.text: I'm getting help again this time. Thank you again.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No. What should I say about this… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Should I say this is a big picture created by Mr. Melvik?)

lines.speaker: 비올렛
lines.text: I need to send someone to my father right away and let him know. The hero Adventurer worked hard this time too… .

lines.speaker: 비올렛
lines.text: I feel like our kingdom has been blessed because so many people have helped us. I'm still waiting for the Sylvaria Empire of Freios as they said they would help me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sylvaria Empire?

lines.speaker: 비올렛
lines.text: Yes, I heard that it is a country ruled by a noble empress. Has Adventurer ever met the Empress?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Not yet. In fact, I haven't even been near the empire.

lines.speaker: 비올렛
lines.text: I see. So, the next time you visit, please tell us about that place.

lines.speaker: 비올렛
lines.text: And I don't know when, but if you visit our estate, I will treat you to a grand banquet. Thank you always.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you. See you later then!
